name: Fast SEO Fix Integration
author: fastseofix

sections.description:
Fast SEO Fix automates your entire SEO blogging: keyword research → content calendar → automated blog post generation → auto-publish to your WordPress site.

This plugin creates a secure connection between your WordPress site and your Fast SEO Fix account. Instead of generating application passwords, you copy a single API key from the plugin settings. That’s it.

Features:

  • One-click secure API key setup
  • Revoke and regenerate your API key at any time
  • Full post publishing: title, content, categories, tags, URL slug, scheduled dates
  • SEO meta support: Yoast SEO, RankMath, All in One SEO (AIOSEO)
  • Featured image support (downloaded and attached automatically)
  • Status dashboard showing posts published and last sync time

External Service Notice:

This plugin requires and connects to Fast SEO Fix, a paid third-party SaaS platform. Content is delivered to your site from the Fast SEO Fix service. An active subscription is required. Review the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy before use.

Requirements:

  • Active Fast SEO Fix account at fastseofix.com

Privacy Policy

This plugin acts as a connector for the Fast SEO Fix service (fastseofix.com).

Data received from Fast SEO Fix:
Incoming API requests from Fast SEO Fix deliver article content (title, body, excerpt, categories, tags, SEO metadata, and optionally a featured image URL). This data is written to WordPress posts on your site and is not forwarded elsewhere.

Outbound connections from your server:
When a request includes a featured image URL, your WordPress server downloads the image from that URL to store it in your media library. No other outbound connections are made by this plugin.

No data is collected from your site visitors or sent to third parties.

  • Terms of Service: https://fastseofix.com/tos
  • Privacy Policy: https://fastseofix.com/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin via the WordPress plugin directory, or upload the zip manually.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings → Fast SEO Fix in your WordPress admin.
  4. Copy your Site URL and API Key.
  5. In your Fast SEO Fix dashboard, add a new WordPress connection and select WordPress (Plugin). Paste the Site URL and API Key.
sections.faq:
Can I revoke an API key?

Yes. Go to Settings → Fast SEO Fix and click Revoke & Regenerate Key. The old key stops working immediately. Update your Fast SEO Fix dashboard with the new key.

Is my data secure?

The plugin only accepts requests authenticated with your API key via HTTPS. The key is stored in your WordPress database and never shared with third parties.

Do I need an active Fast SEO Fix subscription?

Yes. This plugin is a connector — it requires a Fast SEO Fix account to send content to your site.
